Run the cells in order and note the times they print. This page is temporary and will be removed.

## 1. R version and DESeq2 install

```{webr}
R.version.string
t0 <- Sys.time()
webr::install("DESeq2", repos = c("https://bioc.r-universe.dev", "https://repo.r-wasm.org"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
cat("Install + load DESeq2:", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))), "s\n")
```

## 2. Simulated data: 12 strains × 3,000 genes × 12 samples

```{webr}
set.seed(1)
n_strains <- 12; n_genes <- 3000; n_samples <- 12
genome <- rep(sprintf("strain%02d", 1:n_strains), each = n_genes)
mu <- rlnorm(n_strains * n_genes, meanlog = 4, sdlog = 1.5)
counts <- matrix(rnbinom(length(mu) * n_samples, mu = mu, size = 5), ncol = n_samples)
colnames(counts) <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:n_samples)
rownames(counts) <- sprintf("g%05d", seq_len(nrow(counts)))
samples <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(counts),
                      Treatment = factor(rep(c("PBS", "LPS"), each = n_samples / 2), levels = c("PBS", "LPS")))
dim(counts)
```

## 3. DESeq2 on one strain (3,000 genes)

```{webr}
t0 <- Sys.time()
one <- counts[genome == "strain01", ]
dds1 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(one, samples, design = ~ Treatment)
dds1 <- DESeq(dds1, quiet = TRUE)
cat("One strain:", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")), 1), "s\n")
summary(results(dds1))
```

## 4. DESeq2 on all strains, size factors per strain (36,000 genes)

```{webr}
t0 <- Sys.time()
nf <- matrix(1, nrow(counts), ncol(counts), dimnames = dimnames(counts))
for (g in unique(genome)) {
  rows <- genome == g
  sf <- estimateSizeFactorsForMatrix(counts[rows, ])
  nf[rows, ] <- matrix(sf, sum(rows), ncol(counts), byrow = TRUE)
}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts, samples, design = ~ Treatment)
normalizationFactors(dds) <- nf
dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
cat("All strains:", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")), 1), "s\n")
summary(results(dds))
```

## 5. fgsea install (for Part 4)

```{webr}
t0 <- Sys.time()
webr::install("fgsea", repos = c("https://bioc.r-universe.dev", "https://repo.r-wasm.org"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(fgsea))
cat("Install + load fgsea:", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))), "s\n")
```
